name: Laboratory Safety Preparation
description: A five-step demonstration procedure for preparing to enter a supervised laboratory activity.

steps.name: Sanitise hands
steps.prompt: a person sanitising or rubbing their hands

steps.name: Wear laboratory coat
steps.prompt: a person putting on a laboratory coat or protective gown

steps.name: Wear face mask
steps.prompt: a person putting on a face mask

steps.name: Wear safety goggles
steps.prompt: a person putting on protective safety goggles

steps.name: Wear protective gloves
steps.prompt: a person putting on protective gloves
